description: This is a unit test class for the EmployeeWorkExperienceDao, which tests methods related to Employee Work Experiences within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup, CRUD operation tests, and search functionality testing relevant to employee work experience data.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkExperienceDaoTest
classes.description: A test suite for the EmployeeWorkExperienceDao class, covering CRUD and search operations for employee work experience data.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creating a new EmployeeWorkExperienceDao instance and populating test data from a fixture file.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeWorkExperienceById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee work experience by ID and verifies individual fields.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Tests the deletion of employee work experiences by IDs.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Tests searching for employee work experiences with a filter parameter.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeWorkExperienceWithLimit
methods.description: Tests the search functionality with pagination limit.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee work experience and verifies saved data.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeWorkExperience
methods.description: Tests editing an existing employee work experience record.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeWorkExperiencesCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of employee work experiences matching a filter.
